Ignore rules for qltest project files and artifacts.

# Purpose
Defines ignore patterns for `qltest` project files and generated test artifacts. The `*.actual` pattern excludes files with the `.actual` extension, and `test/**/*.testproj` excludes test project files under the `test` directory tree.
